snippet.title: Astro Boy: Omega Factor (GBA) All Bosses + Ending
snippet.description:
Astro Boy: Omega Factor - All Bosses, Hard. "Astro Boy: Omega Factor" is a video game for Game Boy Advance developed by Treasure and Hitmaker, and published by Sega in 2003. The game is based on Osamu Tezuka's manga and anime franchise Astro Boy. However, it also features characters and plotlines from the artist's entire canon of work: Mitsume ga Tooru, Black Jack, etc. Boss list:
00:05 Boss 01 Spider Robot 
00:51 Boss 02 Magnamite 
02:44 Boss 03 Bee & Artificial Sun 
06:52 Boss 04 Amazing Three 
07:11 Boss 05 Big X 
07:58 Boss 06 Pook 
10:13 Boss 07 Atlas 
12:38 Boss 08 Black Looks Swordsman 
13:31 Boss 09 Black Looks Gunman & Carabs 
15:44 Boss 10 Marine Express 
17:31 Boss 11 Deadcross & Roboid 
19:23 Boss 12 Sharaku 
21:46 Boss 13 North, Denkou, Brontus, Epsilon 
30:05 Boss 14 Strongest Robot 
32:51 Final Boss - Garon
36:53 Ending
